interface.longDescription: Not Ai is a source-grounded writing and editing workflow. It protects facts, claims, numbers, citations, terminology, and the author's actual position before improving purpose, information order, specificity, rhythm, register, and clarity. A bundled standard-library Python gate provides contextual editorial prompts and checks required protected text. Not Ai does not classify authorship, promise detector outcomes, or optimize prose for AI-detector scores.

name: not-ai
